lines.say: A T-800 cyborg is sent back in time.
Instead of nineteen eighty-four, he lands in the Jurassic Period.
The year is one hundred and fifty million BC.
No humans. No technology. Just massive creatures everywhere.
The Terminator calculates: threat level, high.
The T-Rex roars. The Terminator doesn't flinch.
The cyborg pulls out his shotgun.
But the T-Rex has thick skin.
He uses his infrared vision to find weak points.
The T-Rex has a vulnerable spot behind the knee.
A pack of Velociraptors surrounds him.
He realizes: this timeline has no Skynet.
From what? From future humans who might destroy it.
He stands guard over the dinosaurs.
A protector of the ancient world.
